composed_by.read_by: the page, from the registry pointer /index serves

river_match.matched_by: the river tag this walk's own records carry (attrs._bank.river)
river_match.why: ?river= names ONE WALK — its layer_code, its key, an unambiguous first segment of its key, or the river tag its own records carry — and this body is that walk's alone. Whether any other banked walk composes the same river is the geo.rivers.v1 registry's and is not banked in Neon (D-09-25-252 §5, pantry lane d091790), so they are named here rather than composed: ?river=willamette answers for willamette_hcr_columbia by itself, never for the basin's nine walks.

gate.rule: drawable only when every item's newest receipt is settled; else the first that is not decides (scripts/nwm_reach_gate.gate_line, THE FUNCTION ported byte for byte from pantry f2a75d1 — not its item set, which is the crosswalk's places[]: see items_absence); n >= 20, tolerance 0.2

verdict_absence.why: the line is `gate_line` — the pantry's own function, ported byte for byte — run over THIS ROUTE's items, so it is this API's verdict over this API's item set. It is NOT the pantry's gate verdict for the reach, which is computed over the crosswalk's placed set: the two sets differ, so the two verdicts can differ, and nothing here claims the pantry's.
